resonant_circuits.goal: A capacitor of capacitance C discharges through a coil of inductance L; the current swings back and forth, its energy moving between the two. Write the frequency f it rings at.
resonant_circuits.name: Resonance of an LC circuit
resonant_circuits.ask: Find f in kHz for a Tesla secondary of L = 0.05 H and C = 2e-11 F.
resonant_circuits.method: Charge obeys L d²q/dt² = −q/C: a harmonic oscillator of angular frequency 1/√(LC).

cyclotron_physics.goal: A charge q of mass m moves across a uniform magnetic field B. The magnetic force bends it into a circle; write how many times a second it goes round, f.
cyclotron_physics.name: Cyclotron frequency
cyclotron_physics.ask: Find f in MHz for a proton (q = 1.602e-19 C, m = 1.6726e-27 kg) in B = 1.5 T.
cyclotron_physics.method: qvB = mv²/r gives r = mv/qB; the time round, 2πr/v = 2πm/qB, does not depend on the speed.
